description: The top 12 identities (fewer on a narrow panel, down to 8) by signal volume, one tile per identity, in a block per kind (named API key, person, cloud API key, platform, user with no email, unattributed); the rest of each kind is folded into one grey "+N more" tile. Area grows with the square root of event volume plus the same small share for every tile, so a quiet identity keeps a readable name but never outgrows a busier one; each tile prints its event count where it fits, at the largest of three sizes that still fits the name and its count (14px on a tile at least 200x100, else 12px, else 10px; a name too long to break at its separators is shortened with an ellipsis and the tooltip has it in full); colour is Risk total (risk weight × events, the quantity the risk leaderboard ranks by) on a square-root scale. A key owner that is an opaque Cloud API key id is shown in the suite's one form for it. Grouped on raw fields first and resolved afterwards, so an identity whose events disagree about its kind is still one tile, in its most specific block.

url.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/main", "elastic.maintenance") OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/search*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/msearch*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/scroll*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/*point_in_time" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/open_reader_context" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/esql*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:admin/esql/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/field_caps*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/async_search/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:admin/resolve/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:admin/shards/search_shards" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "cluster:monitor/xpack/esql/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/project/tags", "cluster:monitor/xpack/inference/get", "cluster:admin/xpack/security/api_key/get", "cluster:admin/xpack/security/api_key/query"))) AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("authentication_success","connection_granted") OR attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time","space_get","space_find") OR (attributes.event.action == "http_request" AND attributes.url.original IS NOT NULL AND attributes.url.original RLIKE "https?://[^/]+(/s/[^/]+)?/((internal|translations|app)/.*|api/content_management/rpc/(get|search|mget|bulkGet).*|bootstrap(-anonymous)?[.]js.*|api/(core|licensing|banners|ui_counters)/.*|api/spaces/space([?].*)?)|https?://[^/]+(/s/[^/]+)?/api/(saved_objects/(_import|_export)|[^?]*/cloud-audit-).*") OR (attributes.kibana.saved_object.type IS NOT NULL AND ((attributes.event.action == "saved_object_get" AND attributes.kibana.saved_object.type IN ("config","config-global")) OR (attributes.event.action == "saved_object_find" AND attributes.kibana.saved_object.type == "index-pattern"))) OR (attributes.kibana.saved_object.id IS NOT NULL AND attributes.kibana.saved_object.id LIKE "cloud-audit-*" AND (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_get","saved_object_resolve","saved_object_find") OR attributes.kibana.session.id IS NULL)))) | STATS n = COUNT(*) BY attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.email, attributes.user.name, attributes.user.domain, attributes.event.action, scc = attributes.elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL, attributes.event.outcome, resource.attributes.service.name, et = MV_CONCAT(attributes.event.type, ","), housekeeping = (attributes.event.action IS NOT NULL AND attributes.event.action == "invalidate_apikeys" AND attributes.user.name IS NOT NULL AND attributes.user.name IN ("elastic.maintenance","autoscaling","elasticsearch-controller","elastic/fleet-server","elastic/kibana") AND attributes.api_key.name IS NULL) | EVAL attributes.event.type = SPLIT(et, ","), attributes.elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change = CASE(scc, "present") | EVAL risk = CASE(housekeeping, 0, attributes.event.action == "invalidate_apikeys", 45, attributes.event.action == "anonymous_access_denied", 35, attributes.elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL, 50, attributes.event.outcome == "failure", 40, (resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((attributes.event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR attributes.event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) AND attributes.event.action IN ("workflow_run","workflow_test","workflow_execution_cancel"), 10, (resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((attributes.event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR attributes.event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) AND (attributes.event.type == "deletion" OR attributes.event.action == "rule_disable"), 30, (resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((attributes.event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR attributes.event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))), 25, 0) | STATS events = SUM(n), severity = SUM(risk * n), scoring = SUM(CASE(risk > 0, n, 0)), authed = SUM(CASE(attributes.event.outcome IS NULL OR attributes.event.outcome != "failure", n, 0)) BY attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.email, attributes.user.name, attributes.user.domain | EVAL actor = CASE(attributes.api_key.name IS NOT NULL, attributes.api_key.name, COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>")), kind_rank = CASE(attributes.api_key.name IS NOT NULL, 6, attributes.user.email IS NOT NULL, 5, attributes.user.domain == "_cloud_api_key" OR (LENGTH(attributes.user.name) == 20 AND attributes.user.name RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT attributes.user.name RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), 4, attributes.user.domain == "_service_account" OR attributes.user.name IN ("elastic.maintenance","autoscaling","elasticsearch-controller","elastic/fleet-server","elastic/kibana"), 3, attributes.user.name IS NOT NULL AND NOT attributes.user.name IN ("<anonymous>","<unauthenticated-cloud-access-token>","<unauthenticated-saml-user>","<unauthenticated-cloud-api-key>") AND authed > 0, 2, 1), owner = CASE(attributes.api_key.name IS NOT NULL, COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.user.name), null) | STATS events = SUM(events), severity = SUM(severity), scoring = SUM(scoring), kind_rank = MAX(kind_rank), owner = MAX(owner) BY actor | EVAL actor_kind = CASE(kind_rank == 6, "named API key", kind_rank == 5, "person", kind_rank == 4, "cloud API key", kind_rank == 3, "platform", kind_rank == 2, "user, no email", "unattributed") | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 500 | KEEP actor, actor_kind, owner, events, severity, scoring | EVAL actor = CASE((LENGTH(actor) == 20 AND actor RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT actor RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), CONCAT(LEFT(actor, 5), "… · Cloud API key"), actor) | EVAL owner = CASE((LENGTH(owner) == 20 AND owner RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT owner RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), CONCAT(LEFT(owner, 5), "… · Cloud API key"), owner)
